### Bio-Rad to Participate in Fireside Chat During UBS Global Healthcare Conference


October 29, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s29.q4cdn.com/260940227/files/doc_news/Bio-Rad-to-Participate-in-Fireside-Chat-During-UBS-Global-Healthcare-Conference-2026.pdf)


HERCULES, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Bio-Rad Laboratories, Inc. (NYSE: BIO and BIO.B), a global leader in life science research and clinical diagnostics products, today announced that its Chief Financial Officer, Roop K. Lakkaraju, will participate in a fireside chat event during the UBS Global Healthcare Conference on Tuesday, November 10, 2026, at 8:00 AM Eastern Time.


A live[webcast](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fevent.webcasts.com%2Fstarthere.jsp%3Fei%3D1781373%26tp_key%3De77a04e85b%26tp_special%3D8&esheet=54631575&newsitemid=20261029474771&lan=en-US&anchor=webcast&index=1&md5=eae93de21f08fb7112ca86e6dc7f0a2a) and subsequent replay of the event will be available in the Investor Relations section of Bio-Rad’s website at[investors.bio-rad.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.bio-rad.com%2Foverview%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54631575&newsitemid=20261029474771&lan=en-US&anchor=investors.bio-rad.com&index=2&md5=01555d44cb045a4b4cf58827dc7fe0b1) .


**About Bio-Rad**


Bio-Rad Laboratories, Inc. (NYSE: BIO and BIO.B) is a leader in developing, manufacturing, and marketing a broad range of products for the life science research and clinical diagnostics markets. Based in Hercules, California, Bio-Rad operates a global network of research, development, manufacturing, and sales operations with approximately 7,400 employees, and $2.6 billion in revenues in 2025. Our customers include universities, research institutions, hospitals, and biopharmaceutical companies, as well as clinical, food safety, and environmental quality laboratories. Together, we develop innovative, high-quality products that advance science and save lives. To learn more, visit[bio-rad.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.bio-rad.com%2Fen-us%2Flife-science%2Fdroplet-digital-pcr&esheet=54631575&newsitemid=20261029474771&lan=en-US&anchor=bio-rad.com&index=3&md5=dd841e9842932ab7ecf27dd9752e8c3c) .
